    Walls that might stack

      An upstairs wall within a foot of a main-floor wall, overlapping for at least a foot. Nothing is snapped across floors until you say which of these are really one wall.

      Not detected here: the picture wall's corner (main floor) against the upper flight's edge and the gallery (upstairs). They are 8½ in apart and meet only through the stair. The film decides that one (frames 1616, 3175, 10673).
